name: AVA Infrastructure Fund
source: 9M 2026 (period ended 30 September 2026, unaudited) added from AVA Capital Plc unaudited consolidated statement of profit or loss, NGX filing library; thousands of naira scaled to naira, group nine-month column. Revenue is the printed Total Income 4,384,893 (net revenue 3,825,968 plus other income 558,925); the separate REVENUE row of 5,872,956 already includes that other income and is not used. Operating Expenses is the printed Total Operating Expenses 1,751,253. EBIT equals PBT because no finance cost line is printed. Income Tax 790,092 and Net Profit 1,843,548 tie exactly to PBT 2,633,640. EPS 0.33 naira is the printed 33 kobo. | CRON 20261014: AVA Infrastructure Fund quarterly report Q2 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), statement of comprehensive income, printed in thousands of naira and scaled to naira. The filing prints two quarterly columns only, Q2 2026 and Q1 2026, so the half year figures are the sum of those two printed columns. Every printed column ties internally and the sums reproduce both identities: interest income 191,209 plus net fair value gains 240,000 equals total income 431,209; total income less total expenses 34,197 equals the printed profit before tax 397,012; and less the printed withholding tax expense 10,689 equals the printed profit after tax 386,323. | AVA Infrastructure Fund annual report and audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NGX filing library, published April 2026), statement of comprehensive income, printed in NGN thousands and stored here in absolute NGN. Operating expenses are the printed administrative expenses NGN 126,856 thousand plus the printed impairment expense NGN 59,610 thousand.
